governing_scope: Runtime acceptance defects discovered after closure of the 20260815 67-issue V550-V552J repair register.

activation_policy.v553_v558_findings: Record immediately but keep DEFERRED until the V553->V558 vertical/horizontal phase begins.

issues.title: directional_applicability_status dropped by schema-limited bridge serialization
issues.evidence: V550 computed authoritative applicability but V551_BRIDGE_INDEX_SCHEMA omitted the field, so persisted Parquet lacked a V551-required column.

issues.title: raw response direction is elided before V551 signed projection
issues.evidence: The V550 bridge explicitly publishes response_direction as blank/NOT_PROJECTED_V550, while V551 _raw_direction() consumes response_direction and makes a candidate NONPROMOTABLE_REPAIRABLE when it is blank.
issues.required_resolution: Separate raw response-category direction authority from V551-owned signed projection. V550 must transmit the authoritative raw directional input without computing V551 signed side/magnitude; do not weaken V551.

issues.title: response_semantics_contract_hash identity grain differs on the live-built response-map path
issues.evidence: ddm_v550_response_options.response_semantics_contract_hash hashes an entire response-map frame and build_response_option_map stamps that one hash onto every row, while V551 scale authority performs exact lookup against 145 distinct response_semantics_contract_hash registry identities.
issues.required_resolution: Bind the canonical V550 response-semantics producer to the same exact contract identities used by the frozen V551 scale registry. Verify the actual smoke/canary response-map hashes against the registry before rerunning.

issues.title: V553 wave harmonization still consumes the legacy V552J handoff-packet contract
issues.evidence: Canonical V552J publishes v552j_structural_join_index.parquet, v552j_v553_input_index.parquet, v552j_to_v553_handoff_index.parquet and v552j_v553_handoff_manifest.json, while V553 wave harmonization still attempts packets/v552j_structural_handoff_packet.json for structural/provenance context.
issues.required_resolution: Repair on the V553 consumer side when V553->V558 work begins; do not change V552J solely to satisfy the obsolete packet contract.

issues.title: retained legacy _impl and adapter contracts duplicate superseded stage interfaces
issues.evidence: Several retained implementation helpers still encode obsolete V551/V552/V552J CLI or readiness contracts, but the governed public smoke wrapper currently overrides them.
issues.required_resolution: During vertical/horizontal consolidation, remove, hard-disable, or contract-test shadow entry paths so supported runtime cannot regress onto superseded interfaces.

nonissues_observed.note: Canonical joint-capable orchestration requests shared-substrate publication when joint authority applies. A direct/non-joint V550 invocation may legitimately omit it; such an artifact cannot later feed V550J without a joint-capable rerun.
